name: The Family and the Fishing Pole

meta.wiki: The Family and the Fishing Pole

summary: Gubber Blump, a dwarf dwelling on the docks of Auberdine, seeks assistance catching native Darkshore grouper. Hostile murlocs prowling the coast have disrupted the town's small fishing boats, leaving Gubber stranded on shore and offering an heirloom rod to anyone willing to cast their line.

sections.title: A Dwarf Far From Ironforge
sections.body: Gubber Blump takes great pride in his lineage, declaring that the Blump name has long been synonymous with the art of angling. While night elves occupy most of Auberdine, dwarves and gnomes have settled into its docks and bustling port facilities. Rather than digging into stone, Gubber spends his days gazing out over the misty waters of the Veiled Sea, eager to haul in the local bounty.

sections.title: Murloc Infestations and Darkshore Grouper
sections.body: The Darkshore grouper is a prized coastal fish, versatile in cooking and famously spirited on the line. Normally, local fishermen would row small craft out into deeper waters to haul them in. However, the aggressive arrival of coastal murlocs has brought civilian boat traffic to a standstill. Fearing the creatures are devouring all the local fish stocks, Gubber recruits travelers willing to angle from the shoreline.

sections.title: The Blump Legacy
sections.body: To reward those who bring him a hearty catch, Gubber parts with a Blump Family Fishing Pole. By his estimation, anyone capable of hauling in a batch of feisty groupers measures up to the legendary anglers of his bloodline—including his bearded, sharp-scented cousin Graun Blump. To a dwarf of his eccentric tastes, handing over a family rod is the ultimate sign of respect.

faq.answer: Gubber Blump is a dwarf fisherman stationed on the docks of Auberdine in Darkshore. Hailing from a proud family of anglers, he teaches basic fishing techniques and passes down his family's signature rods to promising fishermen.

faq.q: Why aren't boats going out from Auberdine to fish?
faq.answer: Hostile murlocs have overrun large stretches of the Darkshore coastline. Their aggressive presence has made launching small personal fishing crafts far too dangerous, keeping local anglers pinned to the piers and shallows.
It is a native saltwater fish found off the misty coast of Darkshore. Anglers prize the grouper for both the challenge of landing one and its versatility in various hearty coastal recipes.
Graun is Gubber Blump's cousin. According to Gubber, she possesses a full beard, smells rather pungent, and stands among the finest anglers their family has ever produced.

faq.q: Why are there dwarves in a night elf town like Auberdine?
faq.answer: Following the Third War and the forging of the Alliance, Ironforge dwarves and gnomes traveled across the sea to Kalimdor to trade, establish maritime links, and assist their new night elf allies with harbor infrastructure.

faq.q: What is the Blump Family Fishing Pole?
faq.answer: It is a sturdy fishing rod crafted and used by the Blump clan. Gubber bestows these treasured poles upon travelers who prove they have genuine angling talent along Darkshore's waters.

angles.text: Finding a fellow dwarf passionately dedicated to fishing rather than subterranean smithing or brewing is an eccentric reminder of your people's varied pursuits.
Darkshore grouper makes for a reliable, nutritious catch along the northern Kalimdor coast, serving as a staple ingredient for frontier camp meals.
Auberdine serves as a vital Alliance port on Kalimdor, where mainland races and night elves cooperate daily against coastal hazards like murlocs.
